pages.text: $(o)The stone exists. We did not dream it: we cut it and we stored it.$(br2)Now it is in your hands, and the Portal is still waiting.

Go back to the Portal. On its platform stands the Receptacle.$(br2)Right-click it to open its window: it will tell you how many blocks it needs and of which kind.$(br2)Place twelve Order's Stones and three Carved Keystones inside, and close the window once all fifteen are in. The Receptacle sets them itself, one by one.
